title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Farm
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Farm. A plot of land used for the scope of farming which can contain buildings and parcels. Subclass of geo:Feature (GeoSPARQL, not modeled here); as a geo:Feature, a Farm inherits the possibility of a physical geometric description via geo:Geometry, exposed here as the NGSI-LD 'location' GeoProperty. See the ex:Farm_Jansen_and_Son_Eindhoven example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 6. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually similar but differently-named 'AgriFarm' entity.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Farm'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. The name of the farm (e.g. 'Farm_Jansen_and_Son_Eindhoven').

location.description: GeoProperty. geo:hasGeometry (inherited from geo:Feature). The physical geometric description of the farm's land.

contains.description: Relationship. geo:sfContains some s4bldg:Building or some Parcel. The buildings (e.g. barns, greenhouses; s4bldg:Building is a SAREF4BLDG class, not modeled here) and parcels contained in this farm.

area.description: Property. Not a declared owl:Restriction on Farm in the ttl, but the s4agri:Area named individual ('The total area of a spatial entity, such as a parcel or a farm.') is explicitly documented as applicable to Parcel/Farm; exposed here as a convenience numeric attribute, in hectares.
